Alex (Security): Quick heads-up: Legal asked us to preserve all auth + proxy logs for a pending investigation. Default retention is 30d; they want a 180d hold just for the affected data set. Can we do a scoped hold without widening general retention?
Mira (SRE): Yes. We can copy matching indices/objects to a governance-hold bucket with object lock and a CMK dedicated to holds. Then set TTL=365d for the hold copy.
Sam (Infra): Important: SIEM partner exports are push-only via export-service principal. Do not expand that principal. Instead create a one-off export job with a narrow query that writes to the hold bucket.
Alex (Security): @Mira can you draft the minimal playbook (commands + metadata) for oncall to run? Legal needs hold identifier.
Jess (Legal): Use tag LegalHold-2026-07-08 in bucket path and metadata. We need chain-of-custody manifest and a scrubbed copy (PII removal). Raw creds must be redacted.
Mira (SRE): Playbook snippet:
1) create s3://redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-07-08/ with Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) and default encryption CMK arn:aws:kms:...:key/hold-cmk
2) export logs by index/time range:
```
# splunk example
splunk search "index=auth OR index=proxy earliest=1620000000 latest=1620086400" | splunk export s3 --bucket redwood-hold --prefix LegalHold-2026-07-08/ --format ndjson
# raw s3 copy
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-raw-logs/2026/07/08/ s3://redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-07-08/ --recursive
```
3) tag objects with metadata: legal_hold_id=LegalHold-2026-07-08, incident=INC-1342, scrub_policy=required
4) run scrub pipeline to produce /scrubbed/ copies (lambda/container)
5) attach custody-manifest.json with hashes + origin indexes
Mira (SRE): After copy, attach S3 Object Lock and set a bucket policy that denies s3:DeleteObject except for infra-admins and denies s3:PutObjectAcl to avoid changing retention.
Sam (Infra): For KMS access, do not grant broad decrypt. Create a KMS grant for role/ephemeral_legal_hold_reader that allows decrypt for the hold CMK only and set grant to auto-expire in 180d. Use STS AssumeRole with external_id=INC-1342.
Alex (Security): Proposed ephemeral role policy: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-07-08/*, logs:Describe* and CloudTrail read. TTL = 180d. Role name: ephemeral_legal_hold_reader_LH20260708.
Sam (Infra): I'll prepare Terraform: role, trust policy (external_id), KMS grant, and S3 bucket policy lock. Also create an export job definition limited by query and principal.
Jess (Legal): Legal will only accept access after scrubbed copies exist. Also need manifest with file hashes and a brief chain-of-custody note.
Alex (Security): Audit requirement: any AssumeRole for the ephemeral role must include session tags reason=LegalHold-2026-07-08 and ticket=SEC-1342. CloudTrail should filter and surface those sessions to SOC.
Mira (SRE): We'll require session tags and configure CloudTrail insights/lookup to flag these assume-role sessions. We'll also emit an internal AuditEvent when scrub-run completes.
Sam (Infra): For SIEM exports: create dedicated export job that writes to held path and add a bucket policy allowing only that export job principal to PutObject to redwood-hold/LegalHold-2026-07-08/*, with explicit Deny delete for everyone except infra-admins.
Alex (Security): Action items: Alex open SEC-1342 and assign, Sam prepare TF snippets + export job, Mira run export + object lock + scrub pipeline, Jess confirm redaction rules and verify manifest.
DevSecBot: [automated] referenced playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/log-preservation. Generated template: create_hold_bucket -> scoped_export -> object_lock -> run_scrub -> attach_manifest -> configure_ephemeral_role.
Mira (SRE): Quick operational Q: some logs include query_params with PII. Recommend scrub step that redacts query params and masks IPs before we hand copies to Legal.
Jess (Legal): Required. Legal will re-open request if scrub isn't adequate. Provide sample scrubbed record format for approval.
Sam (Infra): We'll log scrub operations to the audit trail and include scrub-version in the manifest.
Alex (Security): OK thanks everyone. I'll document this thread in SEC-1342 and link the playbook. :thumbsup:
